newsitem.title: UK: MAM gains as Merrill bid talk grips market.
newsitem.headline: MAM gains as Merrill bid talk grips market.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Group Plc (MAM) surged on Wednesday as a newspaper report fuelled renewed bid speculation, dealers said.
The stock rose 30p to 1,372-1/2p by 0939 GMT on the talk that Merrill was the likely bidder, they said.

MAM has been the subject of perennial bid talk ever since Morgan Stanley's abortive effort to take over SG Warburg, which owned about 60 percent of MAM. MAM was eventually floated off after Swiss Bank Corp bought Warburg.
Tuesday's resurgence of such speculation was fuelled by a report in Wednesday's issue of the Guardian newspaper.
Spokesmen at MAM and Merrill were not immediately available for comment.
